source.title: CHP Otay Mesa Commercial Vehicle Enforcement Facility
source.address: 2335 Enrico Fermi Drive, San Diego, CA 92154
source.finding: CHP identifies this as a facility inspecting commercial vehicles entering California from Mexico.

localEvidence.context: The frozen OSM ways explicitly mark missing border barrier or uncertain access information; adjoining ways name the CHP inspection facility.

assessment: The combined source evidence establishes a commercial inspection context. It does not establish ordinary-car permission or prohibition for each modeled edge. hgv=designated alone is not interpreted as exclusive truck access.
effectOnV3Graph: None. Source uncertainty is diagnostic metadata; the existing static v3 cost/access model is preserved.
